title: Holy mystery: Family demolishes house where Virgin Mary image allegedly appeared
excerpt: A family in Getare-Emenwa, Kisii, has demolished a house after an image allegedly resembling the Virgin Mary attracted hundreds of curious visitors.
content:
• A family in Kisii County demolished a house where an image allegedly resembling the Virgin Mary had appeared
  • The structure developed cracks after hundreds of curious visitors flooded the homestead to catch a glimpse of the reported image
  • The family has since barred all visitors from entering the compound following the structural damage

A family in Getare-Emenwa, Masige East Ward, Nyamache Sub-County has torn down a house at the centre of widespread attention after an image reportedly resembling the Virgin Mary was said to have manifested there.

The demolition came after the homestead was overwhelmed by a wave of visitors drawn by word of the alleged apparition.

House Develops Cracks Under Strain of Crowds

Residents and curious onlookers travelled from various areas to see the image for themselves, with the crowds swelling to hundreds at their peak.

The family said the sheer volume of people who descended on the property caused significant structural damage to the building.

According to the family, the walls developed cracks that rendered the structure unsafe to maintain.

With the house now brought down, the family has moved to prevent further intrusions by barring all visitors from entering the compound.

Family Bars Public From Visiting

The gates are now closed to the public, drawing a firm line under what had become an increasingly unmanageable situation for the household.

The reported appearance had stirred considerable excitement in the area, drawing both the deeply religious and the simply curious.

For a period, the homestead's interior took on the atmosphere of an impromptu pilgrimage site, with people converging daily to witness what many believed to be a miraculous sign.

The family's decision to demolish the structure and shut off access marks a definitive end to that chapter, prioritising the safety and privacy of the household over the public interest the incident had generated.

Image Continues Drawing Reactions

The reported appearance of the image has generated different reactions, with some people viewing it through a religious lens while others remain cautious about making conclusions.

For the family, what started as an extraordinary incident has ultimately brought disruption to their home and forced them to take drastic measures.

As the crowds disappear and the compound returns to normal, the alleged image remains a subject of fascination among those who witnessed or heard about the incident.

Mary Onsombi first noticed the formation on September 4 while tending to her fireplace, and attempts to wipe it away only made it more defined.

Priest Explains Viral Image

Nyamagwa Parish priest Edward Nyakundi addressed the crowd gathered at the homestead, offering a scientific explanation for what residents believed they had witnessed.

He was direct in his assessment, stating that the image was not that of the Virgin Mary and urging residents to stop visiting the property.

The priest explained that the image was a result of water mixing with smoke from the kitchen area to create a pattern that looked like an image.
